steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, Mantra and the others have already returned to the ship.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your guess was correct. Someone is targeting our mission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This instrument is from Ægir?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, can we discover anything from its remaining parts?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No. The Ægir Academy of Technology put a great deal of care into this delicate piece of equipment—Given their pride, I'll bet they made sure no one could ever crack their Little Handy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But the appearance of the Little Handy itself is enough to explain many problems.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, do you remember the Joint Marine Corps?

options: The reason you met with the Ægir consul was to facilitate cooperation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Both the Iberian and Rim Billitonian authorities have responded to our call. The problem is that once cooperation begins, subsequent developments could spiral beyond what we've anticipated.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In recent weeks, the Ægir fleet has not only constructed ports in Iberia, but also established landing sites along the southern coast of Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Ægirs from the deep sea made no immediate move to land. Instead, they quickly carried out a number of operations, including hydrographic surveying, under the banner of 'technical cooperation'.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They also quickly assembled a 'Land Patrol' through a mix of hired personnel and official partnerships, relying on more neutral intermediaries to facilitate cooperation with land-based forces.

options: So you're saying the attackers are the 'Land Patrol.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're still only speculating—but right now, the Land Patrol is the only one that fits all the evidence we've collected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, some consuls don't back Clementia, yes, but that doesn't prove that Ægir is behind all of this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, I am more inclined to believe that someone took advantage of the internal conflicts within Ægir.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Land Patrol near the Iberian border, the mining ship being handed off in Rim Billiton, the mercenaries on the Kazdelian frontier...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The breadth of their deployments and the depth of their knowledge about Rhodes Island's classified missions—that's more than enough to prove that Ægir isn't behind this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, there is no possibility of a rebellion within Rhodes Island.

options: I don't believe that will happen either.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, do you think there's anyone else in Rhodes Island who could do that, besides us?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's right. No one else could do that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, the threats that Rhodes Island faces now are unpredictable.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin also warned us several times—the special patients she is caring for—their conditions are deteriorating faster than she can control.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whether to save our patients or to respond to potential crises, we need more aggressive responses.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've reviewed the records Theresa left in the Black Crown—she also made major breakthroughs through her work on Civilight Eterna.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can visit Civilight Eterna to look for potential help, just like Theresa did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We must carefully assess the risks involved, Amiya.

options: Amiya, are you sure you're ready?
Are there any other more effective means at the moment, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I cannot give you a definitive answer, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I will never stop trying. Any advantage I can gain may help Rhodes Island progress further.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I want to try.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At this moment when the situation is still unclear, I cannot come up with any more effective measures.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But diving recklessly into Civilight Eterna may not lead to the outcome we hope for, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, I cannot agree to such a risky plan.

options: Can Civilight Eterna link to my thoughts?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, that's too dangerous. No one has ever done something like this before! I agree with Dr. Kal'tsit that you shouldn't take the risk.
Kal'tsit recalls the experience of her dear friend, which is not something she is happy to recall.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, Civilight Eterna can do that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She did it before.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, your mind is incredibly complex, but you're not the only one at risk here—Amiya could be exposed to completely unforeseen shocks as well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not agree to this preposterous proposal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, this is my opinion. I cannot interfere with yours and the Doctor's final decision on this matter, but I hope you understand my stance.

options: Amiya, I can open my mind to you completely.
We don't have to force it in one. We can give it a few tries.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, Dr. Kal'tsit...

options: When it's all over, we'll go apologize to her together.
It's not this plan she's opposed to, per se.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I trust you, Doctor.

options: I'll leave the decision of when to stop entirely up to you.
Let's start after I finish arranging the defenses.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Muffled roar)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you worried about me? I'm not mad at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once again, we've arrived at a critical turning point. And last time… Babel met the fate I dreaded most.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It turns out that I can't make sure everything is running on its ideal track, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Raises claw)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Rubs gently)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our own limitations have begun to affect our usefulness in more important endeavors.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We may be able to witness the changes of the stars and the untamed cosmos, but when faced with a real crisis, we're no different from any other creatures on this great land.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Dissatisifed growl)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thank you for comforting me. I can sense your good intentions.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Anxious growl)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, I suppose Amiya and the Doctor have already begun preparing to delve deeper into Civilight Eterna.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not interfere with Amiya's decision. She is mature enough to make the most correct judgment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And the Doctor... the Doctor isn't quite the same anymore either.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe I still have a glimmer of hope in my heart. Maybe, this time the outcome will be different.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Subdued bow)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is true that my own sanity is constantly warning me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Touching the Doctor's mind again with the help of Civilight Eterna is not a sound decision, but Amiya is right, we don't have much choice.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Passionate cry)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, I will protect the Doctor and Amiya.
At this moment, Mon3tr can sense even Kal'tsit's slightest emotions.
Ever since Kal'tsit's latest awakening, Mon3tr has been at her side.
Mon3tr is her companion, the symbiote she personally guides... and more importantly, herself.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Affectionate murmur)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're wrong. I do not feel hopeless, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am delighted that the Ancients overthrew the rule of the Elders, and I am also pleased that Lugalszargus set the starting point for a new civilization.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have made mistakes out of arrogance, but I have also regained my confidence by making dear friends.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Maybe yours and my basic structures will always be alien to this land, but that doesn't mean we will always walk alone.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've found my home, in Rhodes Island, on this great land.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've fulfilled her expectations, Mon3tr. I've learned to love. I've found myself.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Moves confusedly)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Wraps tail around Kal'tsit)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I must protect Amiya and the Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I must protect the true variable here... the future I cannot even glimpse.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've communicated with Civilight Eterna before, yet I haven't been able to break through my own limitations.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Amiya can. Of that, Theresa and I are certain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sure she can pluck significance from the massive trove of data. With Theresa's blessing… she can do it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She is still Amiya, after all. I have seen her grow into a leader with my own eyes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Following in footsteps, she might find some words that one left behind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In the past, when Originium had not yet taken shape, there was an era when luminaries competed to argue with the epoch itself. Their wonderful ideas, born of a desire to celebrate and save lives, still persist.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All is not yet lost, Mon3tr. Terra has a chance, no matter how faint, to keep that hope alive.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Excited howl)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Me? No, Mon3tr, I'm better at memories... remembering the history I witnessed, and have seen erased by time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not special at all.
Kal'tsit calmly inscribes the important info into Mon3tr's spine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the outcome I fear most does come to pass, if the one I least want to see stands in front of us once more—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will engrave this directive into your basic behavioral strategy matrix.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Agitated howling)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Come, Mon3tr. We still have work to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the threat does come, I must ensure that Rhodes Island is Terra's first outpost against the crisis.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I will be your final safeguard.
